source: MuJoCo rendered synthetic images, not real cameras
task_phase: unknown: same-index recording is an offline oracle, not phase recognition
scene: empty, no table, drawer or cube; not calibrated
reference_selection: same frame index from offline recorded trajectory, not online phase recognition
initial_state_source: offline model predicted arm targets injected as simulator initial state; grippers projected to simulator limits, not a closed-loop rollout
recovery_method: feedback proportional velocity, command speed and acceleration limited
safety_check: initial and nominal path contact preflight; actual simulation contact and joint limits; does not prove path safety or hardware safety
training_use: do not use for training until phase, camera mapping, recovery validity, trajectory length, and train/validation handling reviewed
